step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture presents MakeMyTrip's next-gen Security Operations Center (SOC) platform. Ingestion sources on the left include On-Prem infrastructure and an 'AWS' block containing AWS telemetry sources. Per Rule 4, the generic 'AWS' block is decomposed into explicitly named AWS telemetry services from the transcript: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, SQS, and SNS. Ingested events flow into Apache Metron for stream processing and parsing. From Apache Metron, telemetry persists into a Security Data Lake where an EMR job processes data into S3, queried by Athena. A feedback loop arrow connects S3/Data Lake back to Apache Metron to enrich real-time profiles with long-term model insights. On the right, alerts flow from Apache Metron to a SOAR platform (Blitz), presenting incidents to SOC Analysts (Alerts), who then trigger automated mitigation actions on WAF.
